title: Waqt-e rukhsat
body:
Waqt-e rukhsat
(Ya hussain)x3
<<MINI>>
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
(Haye haye) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbala, karbala, karbala, ab imtihan-e sabr-e sarwar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
Door tak jatay howay dekha kiay kartay hussain.
Thukaray kha kha kay khud sambhla kiay kartay hussain Aiye ali akbar zara peechay palat kar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
Ma kay armaano ki chadar ka amaama sar pe hain. Fatima sughra ki ankho ka ujala sar pe hain. Bigray ga ek pal may kitno ka muqaddar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
Dosh par bikhree hovey zulfay ura ti thee hava. Bikhrey zulfo say nikalty ja rahi thee karbala. Maut ki jurrat nahi thi ankh bhar kar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
Uth raha hai gir raha hai ek parda bar bar Umme laila ka ye khayma hai meray parwardigar Lash jab aiye to mar jaiyengi madar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
haye maqtal ghutnio kay bal chala hai is qadar kehta hai awaz de mujhko meray noor-e-nazar kho gaye beenayi meri meray dil bhar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye hussain ibn-e ali Jao na akbar kay karib Zulm aisa hu gaya hai, tab la saktay nahi Kia gawara hai sina sinay kay andar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
Imtiha hai burhay kandhoo ka jawan baitay ki lash Khu mai dubee kis tarhan daikhay gi ma baitay ki lash Is jaga awlad waloo khud ko rakh kar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
Mar te dam akbar ko dar hai ma na ajaye kahi Bahraha hai khu meray sinay say rangin hai zamin Kehdo amma say mujhe yu na taraptay dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba meri ma meray gham ko utha sakti nahi Neend aisey arahi hai, ma jaga sakti nahi Zakhm mera ma ki nazro say bacha kar dekhna
<<MINI>>
(Haye haye) x2
Waqt-e- rukhsat bap ko baitay ka mor kar dekhna
